content.content:
Cheapest: Cha Bar $10, New Punjabi Khana $10, Baba Chicken $12, etc.

Now need flights between cities. Need flight info for each leg: Denver to Colorado Springs? Likely not flights (short distance). Could use self-driving? But transportation field expects flight details maybe. Could use "Drive" as transportation string.

We need day plans for 5 days. 3 cities: Denver (day1-2), Colorado Springs (day3), Grand Junction (day4-5). Include attractions, meals, accommodation.

Find accommodations? Not needed maybe just placeholder "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room, Denver". Use generic.

Now need to submit day plans via function submit_day_plan for each day.

We need to fill fields: day, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation.

Transportation: for day1 arrival flight maybe from hometown? Not given. Could assume starting from Denver via flight. Use placeholder "Flight: XYZ123, from HomeCity to Denver, Departure 08:00, Arrival 10:00". For intra-city travel use "Drive" with distance.

We need distance? Not mandatory.

We'll use attractions: pick from list.

Day1: Denver - Breakfast "Nathu's Sweets", attraction "The Fatty Bao - Asian Gastro Bar, Denver; Denver Art Museum, Denver", lunch "The Fatty Bao - Asian Gastro Bar, Denver" actually that's restaurant. Use lunch "The Urban Socialite, Denver". Dinner "Kloof Street House, Denver". Accommodation "Cozy Downtown Room, Denver".

Day2: Denver - Breakfast "Sweet Sensations", attraction "Red Rocks Amphitheatre, Denver; Denver Botanic Gardens, Denver". Lunch "Yakooz, Denver". Dinner "New Town Cafe - Park Plaza, Denver". Accommodation same.

Day3: Travel Denver to Colorado Springs by drive. Transportation "Drive, approx 2h". Breakfast maybe "Underdoggs Sports Bar & Grill, Colorado Springs" (but breakfast before travel maybe at Denver). Use breakfast "Nathu's Sweets, Denver". Attraction "Garden of the Gods, Colorado Springs; Pikes Peak, Colorado Springs". Lunch "Chin Chow, Colorado Springs". Dinner "Underdoggs Sports Bar & Grill, Colorado Springs". Accommodation "Mountain View Suite, Colorado Springs".

Day4: Grand Junction. Travel by drive from Colorado Springs to Grand Junction (approx 4h). Transportation "Drive". Breakfast "Chin Chow, Colorado Springs". Attraction "Museum of the West, Grand Junction; Western Colorado Botanical Gardens, Grand Junction". Lunch "Cha Bar, Grand Junction". Dinner "Baba Chicken Ludhiana Wale, Grand Junction". Accommodation "Cozy Canyon Cabin, Grand Junction".

Day5: Grand Junction. Breakfast "New Punjabi Khana, Grand Junction". Attraction "Red Canyon Overlook, Grand Junction; Bananas Fun Park, Grand Junction". Lunch "Pizza Station, Grand Junction". Dinner "Coffee Culture, Grand Junction". Accommodation same.

Now call submit_day_plan for each day.

functions.name: submit_day_plan
functions.desc:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

json_schema.description:
Once you have collected information about the trip, call this function once for each day of the trip, starting on day 1.
If a field does not apply for a given day, use "-" to indicate this.
You MUST call this function to save the plan for each query.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"

json_schema.title: submit_day_plan
